search_text: published ZDI-08-045 ZDI-CAN-332 Apple Safari StyleSheet ownerNode Heap Corruption Vulnerability 2008-07-25 CVE-2008-2317 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2008-2317 ['Apple'] ['Safari'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple Safari. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the garbage collection of JavaScript document elements in WebCore. When a CSSStyleSheet object of a style element is copied, and the style element is deallocated, a reference to the ownerNode property of the copied CSSStyleSheet object will result in a heap corruption allowing for the execution of arbitrary code. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Apple Safari StyleSheet ownerNode Heap Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple Safari. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the garbage collection of JavaScript document elements in WebCore. When a CSSStyleSheet object of a style element is copied, and the style element is deallocated, a reference to the ownerNode property of the copied CSSStyleSheet object will result in a heap corruption allowing for the execution of arbitrary code.
